target: scaffold.sh status/merge-regions — a marker-less workflow is NOT region-merged
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/scaffold.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/scaffold-fixture.sh"; export SCAFFOLD_STAMP_PATH=scripts/.agentic-scaffold.json; scaffold_fake_plugin fake 0.10.0; mkdir -p fake/templates/workflows .claude/workflows; printf '%s\n' '// @agentic-loop:begin region=p owner=plugin' 'const P = 1' '// @agentic-loop:end region=p' > fake/templates/workflows/factory.js; printf '%s\n' 'const OLD_INLINE = "pre-region workflow"' > .claude/workflows/factory.js; scaffold_fake_stamp "$SCAFFOLD_STAMP_PATH" 0.9.0 software-unattended .claude/workflows/factory.js; ST=$(scaffold_status fake software-unattended | awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /factory.js/ {print $2}'); MG=$(scaffold_merge_regions fake software-unattended | head -1); LINES=$(wc -l < .claude/workflows/factory.js | tr -d ' '); jq -n --arg st "$ST" --arg mg "$MG" --arg l "$LINES" '{state: $st, merge: $mg, lines: ($l|tonumber)}'
_note: regression found by dry-running the real rollout: merging plugin regions into a workflow that predates markers spliced all four regions ON TOP of the equivalent inline code (114 -> 179 lines, two copies of every stage). A marker-less file must fall back to the whole-file lattice and be replaced, not merged. The lines check proves the file was left untouched by merge-regions.
